# DishGen

> DishGen is an AI-powered recipe and meal planning platform that generates personalized recipes, meal plans, and AI food photography for consumers and food brands.

DishGen offers both free and premium tiers for individual users, plus commercial solutions for food brands and eCommerce platforms. The platform specializes in dietary customization, vegan recipes, wine pairings, and AI-generated content to reduce food waste and streamline meal planning.

## Key Topics

- AI Recipe Generator
- AI Meal Planner
- Vegan Recipes
- Personalized Cooking
- Meal Planning
- Dietary Customization
- Wine Pairing
- DishGen Premium
- DishGen Pro
- AI-Generated Recipes
- Plant-Based Cooking
- Food Waste Reduction
- Recipe Creator
- Kitchen Assistant
- Embeddable Widget

## Core Features

- [AI Recipe Generator](https://www.dishgen.com/create): Main recipe creation tool allowing AI-generated recipes from ingredients or preferences.
- [AI Meal Planner](https://www.dishgen.com/mealplan): AI meal planning tool for personalized weekly meal plans and dietary preferences.
- [DishGen Homepage](https://www.dishgen.com): DishGen homepage showcasing AI recipe generator, meal planner, and premium features.

## Subscription Plans

- [DishGen Premium](https://www.dishgen.com/premium): Premium subscription tier offering unlimited usage and advanced meal planning features.

## Business Solutions

- [DishGen for Business](https://www.dishgen.com/business): B2B solutions page for food brands featuring AI recipe generation and widget integration.
- [DishGen Pro](https://www.dishgen.com/pro): Commercial-grade AI recipe generator for food brands with AI food photography.
- [AI Recipe Generator Widget](https://www.dishgen.com/widget): Embeddable AI recipe generator widget for websites and eCommerce platforms.
